updates.label: Daniel Sroka completes review of interview transcript

descriptionParagraphs.text: On October 17, 2026, Daniel Sroka completed his review and refinement of the transcript of his August 10 evening interview with American Fork Police Chief Cameron Paul and Mayor Bradley Frost.

The initial rough transcript was produced using an automated transcription app, then corrected and revised with AI assistance. Eric Seamons and Daniel Sroka subsequently reviewed and manually revised the text.
The final edited transcript is available as a PDF. The original interview audio is also available so readers can compare the document with the recording.

updates.label: Daniel Sroka authorizes publication of private interview audio
updates.description: On October 14, 2026, Daniel Sroka gave permission for this site to publish audio of a private interview between Sroka, Mayor Bradley Frost, and Chief Cameron Paul.

$override.description: Rob Shelton reports on the federal lawsuit filed October 14 by Sheldon Norcross, Tyler Shaw, Sierra Lauts, and Steven Allen against American Fork City and 13 officers. The complaint alleges constitutional violations; these allegations have not been adjudicated. Ben Schneider is not a plaintiff.
